replay: apply one find/replace, then: cd lean && lake build VE.Presupposition.Examples; restore. `test` lists the #guards that fail when the proofs of Reading.lean and Rows.lean are replaced by sorry (else the broken proofs stop the build first).

mutants.find:
(ms.filter (fun m => m.1 == Root.asserted)).foldr (fun m a => .and m.2 a)
    ((ms.filter (fun m => m.1 == Root.conditioned)).foldr (fun m a => .implies m.2 a) B)
mutants.replace:
(ms.filter (fun m => m.1 == Root.conditioned)).foldr (fun m a => .implies m.2 a)
    ((ms.filter (fun m => m.1 == Root.asserted)).foldr (fun m a => .and m.2 a) B)

mutants.find: | "plural", (some σ, some D, none, none) => .ok (.ex σ D)
mutants.replace: | "plural", (some σ, some D, none, none) => .ok D

mutants.find: r.strong.denote S τ ↔ r.pre.denote S τ ∧ r.weak.denote S τ
mutants.replace: r.strong.denote S τ ↔ r.weak.denote S τ

mutants.find: def assertedAt (f : Frame) (r : Reading) : VE.Formula := .and (f.goal r.pre) (f.plug r.strong)
mutants.replace: def assertedAt (f : Frame) (r : Reading) : VE.Formula := .and (f.close r.pre) (f.plug r.strong)

mutants.find: def conditionedAt (f : Frame) (r : Reading) : VE.Formula := .implies (f.goal r.pre) (f.plug r.strong)
mutants.replace: def conditionedAt (f : Frame) (r : Reading) : VE.Formula := .implies (f.goal r.pre) (f.plug r.weak)

mutants.find: def inPlaceAt (f : Frame) (r : Reading) : VE.Formula := f.plug r.strong
mutants.replace: def inPlaceAt (f : Frame) (r : Reading) : VE.Formula := f.plug r.weak

mutants.find: strong := .and (.ex σ D) (.all σ (.implies D P))
| "generic", (none, none, some b, some p) => .ok (generic p b)
mutants.replace: | "generic", (none, none, some b, some p) => .ok (generic b p)
